scope: Independent CPU-only audit of fixed-history diagnostic harness, sanitized report and complete retained raw logits; no MLX/Metal execution
indexing_explanation: Constructor GenerationBatch._step consumes final prompt token and yields output-index 0 logits. Calls 0..47 correspond to reported 48 output positions. Call 48 is upstream lookahead while output 47 is emitted; retained but excluded from output comparisons. Forced calls consume exactly final prompt token followed by all 48 serial-reference tokens. Captured logits precede forced-logit overwrite.
limitations: Instrumentation synchronously materializes float32 copies of float16 logits and monkeypatches GenerationBatch._step in this standalone process; not a performance trace.
B4 denotes completion capacity, not four active rows each step: divergence shape is [2,1].
Exact tied raw logits plus actual natural output establish the observed boundary; NumPy argsort tie order alone does not prove MLX tie semantics.
Target prefix and logical positions are controlled; surrounding rows, padding, cache shape and batch history differ. This does not isolate a kernel or exclude earlier cache transformation issues.
Single-use private harness refuses its existing output directory; no production runtime edits.
Original strict serial-native model gate and section 3 full acceptance remain false.
